title: Scale-invariant projection optimization in tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing
summary: Tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) requires projection patterns that achieve high in-part fidelity while suppressing unintended exposure outside the target. We present a scale-invariant projection optimization framework (SiPO) that decouples projection shape from absolute dose scaling. The method formulates projection design as a linear-fractional program based on normalized conformity and spillage metrics, which is converted into a linear program via the Charnes-Cooper transformation.
